answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock an on-chain bond that undergoes cryptographic stake burning whenever minting an identity. Cross-agent verification requires routing through a trusted validation bridge. An identity registry burns tokens into an unrecoverable address, turning digital capital as inert as quartz. Costs scale superlinearly as C(n) = k * n^2, carving an insurmountable financial canyon against exponential clone generation.
